capabilities: Render standard and dedicated mermaid blocks as Excalidraw diagrams in Reading view and Live Preview
Fall back to Mermaid SVG images for Class, ER, State, Gantt, Pie, Venn and other unsupported types
Open an enlarged preview with zoom, pan, fit and reset controls
Configure font size, roughness, canvas height, padding and light/dark theme following
Reject resource-capable Mermaid source (images, URLs, metadata) with inline errors before conversion
disambiguation: Not an Excalidraw drawing tool; both displays are read-only and the plugin changes only how Mermaid blocks look, never the Markdown source.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.4+ desktop; mobile is untested. The bundled main.js is about 26 MB, which exceeds Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB file limit, so the plugin must be installed separately on each device. Bundles offline fonts and renderers; appearance is normalized to monochrome and Mermaid's original colors are not preserved.
intentEvidence: The plugin works independently of the Excalidraw community plugin.
problem: Obsidian's core Mermaid rendering only produces standard SVG diagrams, with no hand-drawn style, inline pan/zoom, or enlarged preview.
